extracted.name: Dipping Sauce for Coconut Shrimp
extracted.description: This is a simple and delicious dipping sauce for coconut shrimp, made with orange marmalade, stone-ground mustard, and horseradish.
instruction_lines: Whisk orange marmalade, mustard, and horseradish together in a bowl. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
